tools.name: read_drive_item
tools.description: Read file/folder metadata in your OneDrive by its Graph driveItem ID, returned as id in a Graph item response. A sharing URL or encoded sharing token is not an item ID. No file or folder is created, renamed or moved.

tools.name: list_events_first_page
tools.description: Read the first page of the signed-in user's calendar events. Graph returns @odata.nextLink for more, and this profile never follows it, so only the first page is visible.

tools.name: list_todo_lists_first_page
tools.description: Read the first page of the signed-in user's To Do lists. Graph returns @odata.nextLink for more, and this profile never follows it, so only the first page is visible.
